newsitem.title: USA: Expeditors names European distribution head.
newsitem.headline: Expeditors names European distribution head.

text.p: Expeditors International said it has promoted Stephane Carlier to head its European distribution services, one of a series of appointmentss announced by the company this week.
Carlier had been serving as regional manager - Benelux, for the Seattle-based freight forwarder and logistics provider.
In other appointments, Expeditors named Andy Bryant controller, Europe. He had previously been a regional controller in the London office.
The company said another London-based regional controller, Steven Hodges, was named southwest regional controller for Expeditors (S) PTE Ltd. in Singapore.
In Toronto at Expeditors Canada, Louis Girard was promoted to director, sales and marketing, from manager of commercial development. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
